MERIDIAN YARD DETAILS — LAST VEHICLE 1.16
Original geometry, materials, documentation and generator code prepared for
A GingrSnaps Project, 2026-11-04.

CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0-1.0)
To the extent legally possible, the authors waive copyright and related rights
in this asset pack under the CC0 1.0 Universal public-domain dedication.
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

All six prop designs and their meshes are original numeric geometry authored
in source-assets/yard-v116/build_props.py. Primitive construction and the
shared Yard115 material names and PBR palette derive from the project's
existing CC0 Meridian Service Yard v115 generator. There are no downloaded
meshes, textures, fonts, trademarks, audio recordings or other third-party
asset inputs. Blender is a build tool and is not included in runtime files.

The six v116-yard-*.glb models and source files may be used, modified,
redistributed and sold as part of this game or another project. Attribution
is appreciated but not required. No trademark rights are granted. These
materials are provided as-is, without warranty.
